# Leak Detection NV

> 24/7 Non-invasive water, slab, swimming pool, and gas leak detection across all Nevada cities — Las Vegas, Henderson, North Las Vegas, Spring Valley, Reno, Sparks, Carson City, Pahrump, Mesquite, Boulder City & Elko.

Leak Detection NV coordinates 24/7 non-destructive leak diagnostics and precision repair through independent Nevada State Contractors Board (NSCB) licensed specialists across Southern, Northern, Central, and Rural Nevada. Specialists deploy ultrasonic acoustic listening systems, FLIR infrared thermal imaging, helium/hydrogen tracer gas sniffing, and submersible pool hydrophones to pinpoint hidden leaks without exploratory demolition.

## Core Non-Invasive Services
- [Water Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/water-leak-detection/): High-sensitivity acoustic correlators and FLIR thermal cameras to trace concealed supply pipe failures, freeze splits, and yard mains without exploratory drywall cuts.
- [Slab Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/slab-leak-detection/): Pinpointing pressurized copper and PEX hot/cold lines ruptured under concrete slab foundations, enabling spot repairs or overhead PEX repiping.
- [Pool & Spa Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/pool-leak-detection/): Electronic listening hydrophones, structural dye tests, skimmer throat inspections, and line pressure testing without draining pools.
- [Gas Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/gas-leak-detection/): Digital PPM sniffer devices, ultrasonic detectors, and calibrated manometer drop tests for natural gas and propane lines (Southwest Gas & NV Energy utility unlock support).
- [Underground Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/underground-leak-detection/): Ground-penetrating acoustic sensors and safe tracer gas for fractured irrigation lines, main water service runs, and rural well mains.
- [Emergency Leak Repair](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/emergency-leak-repair/): 24/7 rapid regional dispatch for active water floods, burst pipes, and gas shutoffs.

- [Spring Valley Leak Detection: A Desert Homeowner’s Guide](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/blog/spring-valley-leak-detection-guide/): How desert climate conceals leaks, 5 DIY quick checks, professional diagnostic visit stages, slab vs gas differences, and 2026 cost factors.
- [Signs of a Slab Leak in Las Vegas Homes](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/blog/signs-of-slab-leak-in-las-vegas-homes/): Detailed breakdown of unexplained warm floor spots, continuous running water sounds, cracked tiles, and sudden utility bill spikes.
- [How the Swimming Pool Bucket Test Works](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/blog/how-swimming-pool-bucket-test-works/): Step-by-step DIY methodology to measure true structural water loss versus natural desert evaporation in Nevada temperatures exceeding 105°F.

- [How to Read Your Water Meter for Hidden Leaks](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/blog/how-to-read-water-meter-for-hidden-leaks/): Step-by-step instructions for inspecting the low-flow indicator dial or digital smart meter LCD while all property fixtures remain shut.
- [How to Get an LVVWD Leak Credit](https://www.leakdetectionnv.com/blog/how-to-get-lvvwd-leak-credit-water-bill/): Comprehensive guide for Southern Nevada homeowners to dispute and adjust excessive water bills through the LVVWD leak credit policy with licensed contractor proof of repair.

## Diagnostic Equipment & Methodology
1. **Acoustic Frequency Filtration**: Amplifies the precise sonic signature of pressurized water escaping tiny fissures without drilling.
2. **Infrared Thermal Thermography**: Maps surface temperature gradients to reveal hot-water slab lines, moisture pockets, and hidden wall saturation.
3. **Helium / Hydrogen Tracer Gas**: Non-toxic, inert gas pressurization detected at parts-per-million levels through soil, asphalt, or concrete.
4. **Endoscopic Video Inspection**: High-definition fiber-optic cameras inserted into sewer, drain, and ventilation conduits.
